question: What were total refunds in Mumbai last month?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS refunds FROM refunds r JOIN invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.city = 'Mumbai' AND r.refunded_on >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND r.refunded_on < date('now', 'start of month')

question: Show me revenue by city
sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_paise) AS total FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.city), ref AS (SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_paise) AS total FROM refunds r JOIN invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.city), cities AS (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers) SELECT cities.city AS city, COALESCE(pay.total, 0) - COALESCE(ref.total, 0) AS revenue FROM cities LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.city = cities.city ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the average invoice value?
sql: SELECT AVG(i.amount_paise) AS avg_invoice_value FROM invoices i

question: How many invoices were paid in October?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoices i WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND strftime('%m', i.issued_on) = '10'

question: What is the refund rate?
sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM payments p), ref AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM refunds r) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM pay) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST((SELECT total FROM ref) AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM pay) END AS refund_rate

question: What is the dispute rate?
sql: WITH dsp AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM disputes d), inv AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM invoices i) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM inv) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST((SELECT total FROM dsp) AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM inv) END AS dispute_rate

question: Which customers have the most refunds?
sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS refunds FROM refunds r JOIN invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY refunds DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show me total payments by method
sql: SELECT p.method AS method, SUM(p.amount_paise) AS payments FROM payments p GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY payments DESC
